treatment.name: Braces & Orthodontics
treatment.overview: At Hapliv Dental Clinic, led by Dr. Achla Verma, we specialize in advanced orthodontic treatments including Braces, Invisalign, and General Dentistry. Our goal is to give you a confident, healthy smile with the right treatment tailored to your needs.

types.name: Ceramic Braces
description: Tooth-colored brackets that blend with your teeth.
Aesthetic and less visible than metal braces.

types.name: Self-Ligating Braces
description: Advanced design with fewer adjustments needed.
Comfortable and efficient in aligning teeth.

types.name: Invisalign (Clear Aligners)
description: Transparent, removable trays for a nearly invisible treatment.
Comfortable, convenient, and perfect for adults & teens.
At Hapliv, we provide official Invisalign treatment with precise digital scanning.

cost.note: Final cost depends on the complexity of your case. A consultation with Dr. Achla Verma will give you a customized treatment plan.

before: Cleaning and preparatory treatments if needed.
Personalized discussion about braces vs Invisalign.
during: Mild discomfort in the initial days (completely normal).
Adapting to new eating & oral care habits.
after: Braces removed to reveal your new smile.
Regular follow-ups at Hapliv Dental to monitor progress.

prefer: Soft foods like rice, pasta, yogurt, bananas, and cooked vegetables
foodGuidelines.tip: Brush after every meal to avoid food sticking around brackets.

retainers.importance: Once braces are off, retainers are crucial to keep your teeth in place.
types: Fixed Retainers: A thin wire bonded behind your teeth.
retainers.doctorGuidance: Dr. Achla Verma will guide you on how long and when to wear them.

pros: No need to visit clinic for regular adjustments
cons: Crooked/irregular teeth may worsen over time
Higher risk of tooth decay & gum disease
Chewing difficulties or improper bite may persist
Uneven tooth wear → teeth may weaken or chip
Speech problems in some cases may remain
Jaw pain, headaches, or TMJ issues can develop
Lower confidence & dissatisfaction with smile aesthetics
May require more complex & costly dental treatments later
prosConsOfSkipping.summary: While skipping braces may save time and money in the short term, it can lead to functional, health, and cosmetic issues in the long run. Braces are not just about a perfect smile—they also improve oral health, chewing efficiency, and long-term dental stability.

faq.q: At what age can I get braces?
faq.a: Braces can be started as early as 11-13 years, once most permanent teeth have erupted. Adults can also get braces at any age.

faq.q: How long will I need to wear braces?
faq.a: Treatment usually lasts between 12-24 months, depending on case severity and the type of braces chosen.
Placement isn't painful, but mild discomfort or tightness is common for a few days after adjustments.

faq.q: How much do braces cost in Delhi and Gurugram?
faq.a: Metal: ₹35,000 - ₹65,000 | Ceramic: ₹50,000 - ₹75,000 | Self-Ligating: ₹65,000 - ₹1,20,000 | Invisalign: ₹1,50,000 - ₹3,00,000. Final cost depends on complexity.
Avoid hard, sticky, and chewy foods like nuts, popcorn, chewing gum, caramel, and ice.
